description: Elections Commission - Declare that A. Akileswaran was selected as the member of the Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare that A. L. N. Meera Levve, was selected as the member of the Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha and Akkaraipattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by resignation and party membership changes, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and declarations.
